title: Shapes around us
subject: numeracy
materials: chalk or a stick to draw in the dust
chalk_sketch_svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 120 40" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"><circle cx="22" cy="20" r="14"/><rect x="46" y="6" width="28" height="28"/><path d="M82 34l16-28 16 28z"/></svg>

segments.title: Round things

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: This is a circle. Say it: circle.

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: Find something round in the room. Point to it.

segments.checkpoint: Did most children point to something round?

easier.speaker: guide
easier.text: Look at the sun and a coin. They are round. Circle.
easier.cue: Show a coin or draw the sun

core.speaker: guide
core.text: A plate is a circle. A wheel is a circle. Say circle.

stretch.speaker: guide
stretch.text: Draw a circle on your slate. Draw a smaller circle inside it.

segments.title: Square and triangle

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: A square has four equal sides. A triangle has three sides.

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: Draw a triangle on your slate.

segments.checkpoint: Did most children draw a triangle?

easier.speaker: guide
easier.text: Three lines. One, two, three. That makes a triangle.
easier.cue: Draw it slowly, line by line

core.speaker: guide
core.text: Now draw a square. Count the four sides.

stretch.speaker: guide
stretch.text: Look around. Find a square and a triangle. Tell your partner.

analogy.speaker: guide
analogy.text: A roti is round like a circle. A window is a square. Look for them at home.

ivr_recap.speaker: guide
ivr_recap.text: Find one circle at home and tell your family.
